overloadMerges.note: Added sentinelValues for fieldAtt's documented constants and maxSize's documented 0/negative special behaviors; the draft parser only captured generic Integer/Text types.

params.name: destFolderPath
params.description: Path of the folder to store the exported JSON file(s) (named JournalExport.json).

params.name: maxSize
params.description: Maximum size, in bytes, of each exported JSON file (10 MB default); when reached, the file is closed and a new one started.

sentinelValues.meaning: Reset to the default maximum size (10 MB).

params.name: logPath
params.description: Path of a specific log file (.journal extension) to export; the current log file is used if omitted. Pass an empty string to display the standard Open File dialog. The archived (.4bl) format must be converted with RESTORE first.

params.name: fieldAtt
params.description: How fields are identified in the exported JSON 'fields' objects.

sentinelValues.meaning: Field attribute with number (default if omitted); fields identified by number, e.g. {"5":"Jones"}.
Field attribute with name; fields identified by name, e.g. {"LastName":"Jones"}.

constraints: A negative maxSize removes any file-size limit.
When exporting an external (non-current) log file, fields are always identified by number regardless of fieldAtt.
The path of the selected log file (when logPath is an empty string) is returned in the Document system variable.
